BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to highways of statewide significance; and amendingRCW 47.05.022.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.05.022 and 2002 c 56 s 302 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature designates ((that portion of state route number 509that runs or will run from state route number 518 in the north to theintersection with interstate 5 in the south as a state)) as highways ofstatewide significance those highways so designated by transportationcommission resolution number 660 as passed on January 21, 2004.
